# TwitSticker (gifsticker.site)

> Convert Twitter and X videos & GIFs into transparent animated WhatsApp stickers under 500 KB with 1 click.

## Core Capabilities
- **Twitter to WhatsApp Sticker Conversion**: Converts viral videos and animated GIFs from Twitter/X links into official 512x512 WebP animated stickers compliant with WhatsApp's strict file size limit (< 500 KB).
- **Embedded WhatsApp EXIF Metadata**: Injects custom sticker pack name, publisher author, and emoji tags into the WebP container for native WhatsApp keyboard recognition.
- **WhatsApp Web & Desktop Support**: Copy sticker directly to system clipboard to paste into WhatsApp Web (Ctrl+V) as a real transparent animated sticker.
- **Android Native 1-Tap Add**: Includes companion Android app with ContentProvider integration to add packs directly to WhatsApp without third-party tools.
- **Direct Sticker Sharing**: Every converted sticker generates a shareable link at `https://gifsticker.site/sticker/<id>` with rich OpenGraph preview cards for social messaging apps.

## Key Links & Resources
- [TwitSticker Home](https://gifsticker.site/): Web app and converter interface.
- [Sitemap](https://gifsticker.site/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for search crawlers.
- [Robots](https://gifsticker.site/robots.txt): Crawler permissions and index directives.
- [Ads.txt](https://gifsticker.site/ads.txt): Authorized digital sellers declaration.
- [Android App APK](https://gifsticker.site/download/twitsticker.apk): Companion Android application for direct 1-tap WhatsApp installation.

## Technical Specifications for WhatsApp Stickers
- Resolution: Exactly 512x512 pixels
- Format: Animated WebP (`image/webp`) with alpha transparency
- Max Size: Under 500 KB total file size
- Frame Rate: Optimized 9-16 FPS
- Max Duration: 3.5 seconds recommended for smooth infinite loop
